title: Concept: Test runner report published with the app
description: A test runner result document with its counters in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The report carries suite names, assertion counts and failure text, which describes internal modules and the assertions that guard them.
applicability: Deployments that render a test runner result document with its counters into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The report carries suite names, assertion counts and failure text, which describes internal modules and the assertions that guard them.
